unseen_predictions.statement: Fresh-queue R@1 declines monotonically as capacity increases, with at least one practically material step.
unseen_predictions.if: fresh reprojected queue capacity increases at fixed batch, data, optimizer and schedule
unseen_predictions.then: mean bidirectional R@1 will decline monotonically from queue-free through 1,024, 4,096, 16,384 and 65,536 entries
unseen_predictions.because: the residual damage is caused partly by the amount of current-space negative mass rather than staleness alone
unseen_predictions.failure: a non-monotonic curve replicated across seeds, or differences below 2 percentage points

unseen_predictions.statement: Semantic filtering beats matched-random filtering by at least 2 percentage points.
unseen_predictions.if: queued negatives above the frozen MobileCLIP2-S0 cross-modal guard are removed
unseen_predictions.then: R@1 will exceed the matched-random-removal arm by at least 2 percentage points
unseen_predictions.because: semantically valid alternatives are being treated as negatives
unseen_predictions.failure: semantic filtering fails to beat matched-random removal by 2 percentage points

unseen_predictions.statement: Mass normalization beats the unweighted fresh-queue control by at least 2 percentage points.
unseen_predictions.if: the total nominal queue denominator mass is normalized to the in-batch gallery mass
unseen_predictions.then: R@1 will exceed the unweighted fresh-queue control by at least 2 percentage points
unseen_predictions.because: the queue otherwise overwhelms the gradient with many detached candidates
unseen_predictions.failure: mass normalization fails to recover 2 percentage points

stopping_rule: Run the six capacity cells, then the nine fixed-capacity mechanism cells. Do not tune thresholds, weights, capacities or seeds after observing outcomes.
disclosures: The MobileCLIP threshold was calibrated before this study on one million different-owner COCO-training pairs.
The semantic and matched-random arms remove exactly the same number of queued candidates per query.
The queue-free, 16,384-entry and 65,536-entry controls are reused; they are not retrained.
